summary: A small description of the lessons-learnt-v2 tool (name, subtitle, status, icon and address), kept apart from its page so the app can list the tool without loading the page.
purpose: Give the app what it needs to show the tool in lists.
why: Likely reason: keeps the tool list light by not loading page code. Reason not stated in the code.
how: 1. Imports the icon and the tool description type. 2. Exports an object with the descriptive fields. 3. A type check confirms the fields match the tool description shape, without requiring the page component.
inputs: None at runtime. The values are fixed text and an icon.
outputs: A description object read by the app's tool list.
risks: The same values appear in index.tsx. Editing one and not the other shows different names or addresses. A type mismatch stops the build instead of failing later.
debug: If the name or status looks wrong in the tool list, compare this file with the entry in index.tsx. If the build fails here, check that each required field is present and spelled correctly.
